mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Weak consumer credit demand (RSAFS < 340000 million dollars) combined with restrictive monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%) signals suppressed equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS < 340000 and FEDFUNDS > 3.5%, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) suppresses corporate profit growth through labor market slack, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months indicates strong labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS increases over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 2000 thousand units, it signals weak consumer demand for housing and related sectors, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 2000, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 115) combined with weak GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0% annualized) signals economic slowdown that depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 115 and GDPC1 growth < 1.0%, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 115) signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 115, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
